regime_detail: baselines.json: D (observational files) and D+I (GIES on obs_int files); oracle_check and fault_suite are checks, not scores
orientation_rule: undecided pairs oriented at random with a per-file seed, crc32(file name) (the AB-01 expectation rule)

metric_defs.dv1_precision: DV-1 committed-claim precision against released targets
metric_defs.dv1_coverage: share of target-outcome pairs with a committed claim
